summary: On the phone a long press on a conversation entry selects its text where it is, with iOS's own handles and menu, instead of opening a sheet, and every conversation says how fresh it is (live, updated 1m ago) and shows when the phone is asking st again

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No schema, operation or contract digest change. iOS app and shared TypeScript views only.

rules.detail: No claim, checkpoint, retention or authority rule change.

downtime.detail: Client-only change; a new phone build is needed to see it.

manual.detail: A new phone build must be installed.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
